name: Welch's 100% White Grape Juice
whyItWorks: A 100% fruit juice made from Niagara grapes with zero added sugar, zero fiber, and notably low titratable acidity compared to citrus juices. Clear and non-staining, making it universally acceptable during clear liquid protocols.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Dilute 50/50 with water or ice during active flares to lower the osmolarity and prevent rapid dumping.
